title: Flustered brown sugar and orange cake
description: First, it’s one minor defeat, then another, and it’s beginning to feel like a pattern of failures. The stress that’s building is heading toward panic and dangerously close to quitting territory. It’s frayed nerves, physical and mental clumsiness, and agitated confusion - it’s threatening to overwhelm the system. It’s that flustered feeling again... It takes over if there’s no simplifying the situation. Ignoring it, or worse, trying to stick it out, leads to more struggle. Consider taking a breather, reassessing the situation, and managing your priorities. Step away from this flustered mood (and bake).
ingredients: 3 ½ cups (532 g) all-purpose flour, ½ tsp salt, 1 tsp baking soda, 4 tsp baking powder, 1 ½ cup (320 g) brown sugar, 1 ½ cup vegetable oil, 4 large eggs, 1 tbsp vanilla extract, 3/4 cup milk, 1 cup orange juice

title: Cozy spiced pumpkin tea affogato
description: When it’s fuzzy sweaters on cold days and reading by the light. It’s leaves changing color and the world turning red, gold, and dewy. It’s starting to take shape….that ever familiar warm and cozy feeling that fills you up from the inside out. That’s when it’s time to enjoy the unmistakable blend of pumpkin and spices in an enchanting mix of cold and warm. It’s like embracing all things cozy in one delicious cup. Indulge in the cozy mood (and bake)!
ingredients: 3 inch (46 g) fresh ginger, peeled and roughly chopped, 6 cups water, 6 tea bags, 4 tbsp (50 g) brown sugar, 1 ½ cups pumpkin puree, 12 cloves, 9 cardamom pods, 1 inch cinnamon stick, Vanilla ice cream

title: Overconfident maple marshmallow cookies
description: Overconfident but aware - it’s knowing something might not work but going for it anyways. It’s feeling certain with a hint of the unknown, it’s reckless with a thoughtful gaze, it’s bold yet carefully so. It’s a rare, and exciting, mix of emotions. It’s the perfect storm and the best conditions for tackling THE list. The list that’s been filled with every intriguing, exciting, unexpected thought that’s low priority but still too interesting to ignore. It’s time to work off the list, take the risk, have your fun, and do it again tomorrow. Enjoy this overconfident mood (and bake)!
ingredients: ½ cup (113 g) unsalted butter, room temperature, ¾ cup (161 g) brown sugar, 2 tbsp (28 g) white sugar, 2 large egg yolks, ½ teaspoon maple extract, ¼ cup maple syrup, amber grade, 1 ½ cups (232 g) all-purpose flour, 1 teaspoon baking soda, ¼ teaspoon salt, ¾ cup (48 g) mini marshmallows

title: Restless caramelized apple pancakes
description: Restless and stuck in an anxious, agitated, fidgety loop. It feels endless and uncomfortable with no place to settle. There’s an edge to the mood that’s adding tension to the air. Figuring out what to do is second only to determining if it’s worry-induced or a result of boredom as each may require something different. Whatever the reason, if there’s nowhere to settle may as well keep moving - lingering does not benefit. Find something that will help or distract, whichever fits the mood, and almost always, bake.
ingredients: 1 cup (148 g) all purpose flour, 1 tsp baking powder, ½ tsp baking soda, 1 ½ tbsp brown sugar, ½ tbsp cardamom powder, 2 tbsp (28 g) salted butter, melted, 1 cup milk, 1 large egg, 3 ½ tbsp water, 4 apples, sliced into thin wedges, 2 tbsp brown sugar

title: Energized bruleed banana with coffee-glazed pound cake
opening_title: bruleed banana with coffee-glazed pound cake
description: The heady mix of feeling energized AND motivated at the same time is as rare as it is special - it’s electric. It’s hard to sit still when the mood is this exciting. There’s an urge to take advantage of the moment because it feels intriguing but also fleeting. It’s time to seize this energized mood and move... And once you get moving - things will fall into place. You might find yourself in an even better position than when you started. Keep the energy going with a fun and special treat. Relish this energized mood (and bake)! Well, not bake, brulee. Brulee a banana. A banana coated in sugar and caramelized to perfection.
ingredients: 1 Banana, cut in half, lengthwise, ¾ tbsp granulated sugar, 2 slices of pound cake, ½ tsp instant coffee powder, ½ tsp granulated sugar, ¾ tsp hot water, 2 tbsp walnuts

title: Playful burnt honey raspberry cake
description: Playful. It’s silly, cheerful, and light. It’s the balm you didn’t know you needed until it appeared, and once it arrived, it’s exactly what was missing. For the most part, time flies and laughter ensues. There’s no room for embarrassment or self-consciousness, only enjoyment that lingers and lasts. Playfulness, like this, is too fun to resist. It’s the best way to spend the day. Take advantage of this playful mood (and bake)! Bake a cheery honey-raspberry cake. A cake that’s as playful as the mood.
ingredients: 2/3 cup honey, ¼ cup water, 3 ½ cups (532 g) all-purpose flour, ½ tsp salt, 1 tsp baking soda, 4 tsp baking powder, 1 ½ cup (320 g) sugar, 1 ½ cup vegetable oil, 4 large eggs, 2 tbsp vanilla extract, 3/4 cup milk, 170 g fresh raspberries, chopped

title: Vibrant lemon raspberry muffins.
description: When the situation looks gray and gloomy - it spreads a feeling of darkness over the rest of the day. It creates a difficult, messy, sadness that blocks out the light... Add some vibrant, bright colour back to the day. Change direction, get moving, do something fun, and don’t give up. This feeling is temporary. Create a vibrant mood around you (and bake)!
ingredients: 2 cups (304 g) all purpose flour, ¼ tsp salt, ½ tsp baking soda, 2 tsp baking powder, ¾ cup (160 g) sugar, ¾ cup vegetable oil, 2 large eggs, ¼ cup honey, 3 tsp lemon juice, ½ cup milk, 74 g raspberries, chopped, 8 g grated lemon zest (2 lemons)

title: Radiant rose tea with mint and lemon.
opening_title: rose tea with mint and lemon.
description: Filled with light - that’s the mood. It feels like sunshine; glowing and radiant. It ignites an unshakable strength that’s lit-from-within and anything feels possible. It’s a beautiful outlook, one that’s special every time it surfaces. It’s worth taking extra time to immerse yourself in this radiant mood (and bake)!
ingredients: 2 orange pekoe tea bags, 3 cups boiled water, 2 tbsp brown sugar, 4 mint leaves, 1 ½ tsp rose water, 1 lemon slice

title: Amused coffee-glazed french toast.
description: When that silly mood hits - the fun begins, and the best ideas come out to play. How can they not with such a lighthearted, carefree, amused vibe to work with? And the antics? They're playful, usually funny, and thoroughly enjoyable. This is the perfect opportunity to try something new and to have fun with it. Anything's possible with a little fun - like putting two things together into one combined (magical) thing? Yes!! Time for an experiment! Enjoy this amused mood (and bake)!
ingredients: 4 mini brioche buns, cut in half, 1 egg, 1 tbsp milk, 3 ½ tsp granulated sugar, 2 tsp coffee powder, Unsalted butter, for frying, Maple syrup and powdered sugar, for serving

title: Unsure double chocolate cake.
description: Most days, there’s an innate sense of certainty toward most things. It inspires confidence that’s quick to spread but, not today. Today, it’s a feeling that’s hesitant and unsure. It’s surprising how quickly it changes the mood... How to get back on steady ground when everything’s coming up loud and vibrant and full of emotion? Look inward, take the time to think things over, talk to a friend, and find your footing. The answers, along with confidence and certainty, are sure to follow. Until then, relax into this unsure mood (and bake)!
ingredients: Spray oil, for greasing the bundt pan, ½ cup (110 g) semi-sweet chocolate chips, 2 ¾ cups + 1 tbsp (329 g) all purpose flour, ½ cup (75 g) cocoa powder (or dark cocoa powder), ½ tsp salt, ½ tsp baking soda, 1 tsp baking powder, ¾ cup vegetable oil, 2 cups (368 g) granulated sugar, 4 eggs, at room temperature, 1 tsp vanilla extract, 1 cup buttermilk

title: Merry honey lime cake.
description: There’s a delightfully cheerful energy to the sights, smells, and sounds lately. It’s everywhere, and it’s everything! It’s the scent of freshly baked goods wafting sweetly through the air and twinkle lights sparkling in every direction. Life and the everyday is steeped in colour. The mood is effortless, almost merry, and it’s easy to stay awhile... If the season doesn’t speak to you, you’re not alone, but if the mood brings you joy, then by all means, enjoy. Happiness and kindness are worth sharing. Spread the merry mood (and bake)!
ingredients: 2 cups (304 g) all purpose flour, ¼ tsp salt, ½ tsp baking soda, 2 tsp baking powder, ¾ cup (160 g) sugar, ¾ cup vegetable oil, 2 large eggs, ¼ cup honey, 3 tsp vanilla extract, ½ cup milk, 2 tsp (2 g) lime zest (about 1 lime)

title: Lighthearted spiced plum tart.
description: There’s a lighthearted vibe in the air - it’s carefree, exciting, and deliciously contagious! Perfect as the festive season approaches. A wonderful time of year when it’s bustling with anticipation and child-like delight! Linger over that lighthearted feeling and stay awhile. Add some cheerful music, a few nostalgic and familiar sights, some togetherness and laughter and you’ve got yourself a party! Savour this lighthearted mood (and bake)!
ingredients: 3” tart shells, 4 of them, ¼ tsp spiced rum, divided, 66 g dark plums, chopped (about 1 plum), 45 g vanilla pudding, Whipped cream (premade or follow the recipe below):, 125 ml heavy cream, ½ tbsp granulated sugar, ¼ tsp vanilla extract, Pinch of cinnamon powder

title: Evolving spiced ginger pumpkin iced tea.
description: Something’s different, something’s changed – it feels better. After a slow, gradual, evolution; progress, unexpected, amazing progress. Progress that took every little bit of energy and purpose to achieve. The benefits were many... Now, it’s time to take it in and pause on the perfecting. Stop constantly searching for a measure of growth, a shift in the air, or a hint of success. When you’re ready – come back to growing, developing, and evolving. Until then, consider the progress. Unwind, check-in, re-evaluate (and bake)!
ingredients: 3 inch (46 g) fresh ginger, peeled and roughly chopped, 6 cups water, 6 tea bags, 4 tbsp (50 g) brown sugar, 1 ½ cups pumpkin puree, 12 cloves, 9 cardamom pods, 1 inch cinnamon stick, Ice

title: Cramped banana walnut pancakes with maple cream.
opening_title: banana walnut pancakes with maple cream.
description: It’s that cramped feeling again. Why? Let’s see - it’s midway through a busy week month, it’s chaotic with no signs of slowing down, and it’s always this busy. It’s a habit because, and this is the worst part, it’s possible to do it all. It’s possible but it’s stressful and that means no fun. Let’s slow things down and take a few items off the list. This habit of being busy all the time, it’s getting old. Let’s make a new plan - one that’s not so stuffy. And when the new plan looks good, add something that’s just for you, something that makes the week feel better. It can be anything – a coffee date with an old friend, a class or workshop to make new friends, a walk around the block, a small break from the usual…it’s your choice. Start with something to shift your focus and add a little fun. Contemplate this cramped feeling (and bake)!
ingredients: 1 large banana, mashed, 1 cup + 2 tbsp (166 g) all purpose flour, 1 tsp baking powder, ½ tsp baking soda, 3 tbsp (40 g) brown sugar, divided, 2 tbsp (28 g) salted butter, melted, 1 cup milk, 1 large egg, 3 tbsp water, 1 tbsp vanilla extract, ¼ cup (28 g) chopped walnuts

title: Ready caramelized apple and coconut muffins.
description: It’s a busy, fun, (mildly) chaotic time when everything seems just a little more crazed – typical for this time of year. The busy summer’s wrapping up, the temperatures are cooling down, the sweaters are out, and in contrast, the thoughts feel clearer. It must be the crisp air. There’s lots to do and the list keeps growing but there’s very little stress. Mostly, there’s a sense of being ready for whatever comes next. It’s hectic but exciting - the perfect mix! This mood is everything. It feels easy because it’s fun!! Welcome this ready mood (and bake)!
ingredients: ¼ cup + 2 tbsp (30 g) unsweetened desiccated coconut, toasted, 2 cups (236 g) apple, diced (approx. 2 medium apples), ¼ cup + 2 tbsp (30 g) brown sugar (or 2 tbsp caramel sauce), 1/8 tsp of kosher salt, 2 cups (304 g) all purpose flour, ¼ tsp salt, 4 tsp baking powder, ¾ cup (166 g) sugar, ¾ cup vegetable oil, 2 large eggs, ¼ cup + 2 tbsp maple syrup, ½ tsp vanilla extract

title: Gloomy pound cake fruit salad.
description: When it’s not just the weather, the gloomy feeling is the mood. It’s dark, cloudy and a little sad but, it’s also quiet, reflective, and surprisingly peaceful. The emotions, they’re fitting as they play out in the weather. There’s a strong pull to stop just to soak in the rain and the mood... And if the mood’s a little gloomy and you’re on the verge of a downpour, take comfort in knowing that you can bring a little light to the rain. Put on the comfy pyjamas, grab a cup of hot tea, and sit back. If the mood can be reflected in the weather, then eventually the weather (and the mood) will change. Make your way through this gloomy mood (and bake)! Actually, not bake. Cake. Toasted cake. Toasted pound cake in fruit salad. A combination... that’s sweet, tart, and honeyed with an irresistible mix of flavours and textures.  It’s a dessert that’s bright and cheery, and easy to make. It’s understated and effortless.
ingredients: 4 thick slices of pound cake, cut into 4 strips each, Drizzle of honey (optional), 12 Raspberries, 20 peach slices from a can, 8 Strawberries, cut into pieces

title: Serene mint rose tea.
description: On an unusually quiet day when it’s especially calm and peaceful, life slows down and it feels like a dream. There’s an unmistakable stillness that hits the mood and the senses like a wave - striking and startling all at once. It shifts from calm and serene to jarring and uncomfortable just like that. Questions and confusion overwhelm the quiet, a nagging disbelief and an alarming amount of doubt turn the once peaceful day away. Maybe it doesn’t have to be that way. Maybe, instead of the usual evolution of the day you choose to embrace the calm and take comfort in the peace? Drink in this serene day (and bake)!
ingredients: 3 mint leaves (1 tbsp), 2 cups (500 ml) water, ½ tsp rose water

title: Sunny honey loaf cake.
description: Sitting outside in the warm sun after a long, dark stretch is a mood. It’s a welcomed relief to see the sun shining, to notice the green grass, and enjoy the sweet smell in the air. It’s too lovely to leave. If it could be bottled, it would be like releasing a breath of fresh air anytime you need it. Since it can’t be, maybe it can be enjoyed another way... What if this bright mood could be baked into a deliciously fluffy, summery cake? A cake to be enjoyed as a little ray of sunshine on a dark day. What’s better than reminding yourself the dark days, they don’t last? You are going to get yourself through it. Spread this sunny mood (and bake)! And bake cake. Delightful cake. Golden honey cake.
ingredients: 2 cups (304 g) all purpose flour, ¼ tsp salt, ½ tsp baking soda, 2 tsp baking powder, ¾ cup (160 g) sugar, ¾ cup vegetable oil, 2 large eggs, ¼ cup honey, 3 tsp vanilla extract, ½ cup milk

title: Wednesday luscious fudgy brownies.
description:
It's an ordinary day, nothing new or noteworthy’s happening. It’s business as usual but something’s missing. What? Wait. What’s today? It’s not Monday (because that would be obvious). It’s certainly not Friday or the weekend - nothing exciting is happening. It’s probably one of the middle-of-the-week days. Checking the calendar…it’s Wednesday. So, it’s going to be like any other day smack dab in the middle of the week. Or it’s the second longest and equally toughest day of the week (behind Monday)... Then it hits you ... déjà vu ... what day is it? Never mind, you can shape whatever day it is any way you want and enjoy it just as much. It’s time to own Wednesday (and bake)!
				And bake brownies. Not just any brownies. Exceptional brownies. Luscious brownies.
ingredients: ¾ cup (170 g) unsalted butter, 3 oz (90 g) semi-sweet chocolate chips, 2 large eggs, at room temperature, 1 ½ cups (300 g) granulated sugar, 2 tbsp flavoured coffee creamer such as Bailey’s (non-alcoholic) coffee creamer or for a grown-up taste Bailey’s Irish Cream, ¾ tsp coarse salt, ½ cup (40 g) cocoa powder, ½ cup (70 g) all-purpose flour

title: Conflicted chocolate chip peanut butter ripple cookies.
opening_title: chocolate chip peanut butter ripple cookies.
description: Feeling conflicted – do you want option “a” or option “b”? Both work but you have to choose one. Hmm…option “a” has a lot of things going for it but option “b” looks so good! What do you do? You reaaaaally like both of them. Hey, you know what? You’re in charge here. If you have to choose then choose BOTH (and bake)!

title: Uptight coffee butterscotch pudding.
description: Feeling uptight? It’s a tense, nervous, jittery place with no room to move – not fun unless you’re okay with rigid and stuffy. If you’ve been at it for a while, you know it’s exhausting but, maybe you don’t have to stay with it. Maybe there’s something you can do, steps you can take, to distance yourself from it. Find something relaxing to take your mind off it or determine why you’re there and work your way out. Either way, it’s time to do something different (and bake).
ingredients: 1/2 tsp instant coffee, 1/2 tsp milk, warmed, 90 g vanilla pudding, Serve with vanilla wafers, oreo cookies, or fresh strawberries

title: Extra coconut chocolate chip cookies.
description: I’m feeling a little *extra* today. Not the slang “extra” (trying too hard, over the top, excessive, and dramatic), but the “I want a bit more, a little excess, some frill” kind of extra. And it’s so much fun!! The great part about it is it doesn’t have to be complicated or extreme. I’m just looking for a little more…pep. I think I’ll bake...
ingredients: ½ cup (113 g) unsalted butter, room temperature, ¾ cup (161 g) brown sugar, 2 tbsp (28 g) white sugar, ½ tsp – 1 tsp coconut extract*, 2 large egg yolks, ¼ cup maple syrup, amber grade, 1 ½ cups (232 g) all-purpose flour, 1 teaspoon baking soda, ¼ teaspoon salt, ¾ cup (143 g) semi-sweet chocolate chips, *for a lesser coconut flavour use the lower value

title: Heavy spiced peanut butter mousse
description: I feel heavy with the weight of my thoughts. The longer I’m dealing with it, the harder it is to manage. It’s making everything else seem dark and sad. When will it let up? I need a break from it. A breather would help too, and then a plan to relieve the strain. There’s lots to do, so I’ll start small. I think I’ll bake...
ingredients: 3 tbsp whipping cream, 2 oz cream cheese, room temperature, 3 tbsp (42.5 g) peanut butter, 3 tsp granulated sugar, ½ tsp vanilla extract, ½ tsp clove powder, plus more for dusting, ¼ cup whipping cream, 1 tbsp sugar

title: Sassy lemon maple cream cookies.
description: I feel sassy and that makes me bold... Time to do something fun, something that’s a little bit of a risk and commit to whatever the outcome. Simple, let’s start somewhere fun. I think I’ll bake...
ingredients: ¼ cup (47 g) vegetable shortening, ¼ cup (57 g) unsalted butter, room temperature, ½ cup + 2 tbsp (125 g) granulated sugar, 1 large egg, room temperature, 2 tbsp maple syrup, 1 ½ tsp lemon extract, 1 ½ cups (225 g) all-purpose flour, ¼ tsp baking powder, heaped, ¼ tsp baking soda, ¼ tsp salt, 1 oz cream cheese, softened, 1 ½ tbsp powdered sugar, ½ tsp maple extract, ¼ cup heavy cream

title: Divided coffee swirl cake.
description: I feel divided, of two minds, conflicted. Which way should I go – this way or that? *Or* this way or that? All this jumping back and forth is unsettling. While I’m weighing my thoughts (and getting down to the business of answers), I think I’ll bake.
ingredients: 1 ¼ cups + 2 ½ tbsp (164 g) all purpose flour, Pinch of salt, ¼ tsp baking soda, ½ tsp baking powder, ¼ cup + 2 tbsp vegetable oil, 1 cup (184 g) granulated sugar, 2 eggs, at room temperature, ½ tsp vanilla extract, ½ cup buttermilk, 1 tbsp instant coffee, ¾ tsp granulated sugar, 1 tsp hot water

title: Pressure honey milk tea muffins.
description: There’s a lot of pressure on all sides these days. It takes on different forms but it’s all the same in the end. It’s the weight (of it) that’s the hardest to manage – it can be crushing, and I don’t like it. I want to press on and do what I gotta do but it’s hard to rally under all this stress. I know I can do this though; I just need something to guide me through and maybe give me a little energy. I think I’ll bake.
ingredients: ½ cup milk, 2 orange pekoe tea bags, 2 cups (304 g) all purpose flour, ¼ tsp salt, ½ tsp baking soda, 2 tsp baking powder, ¾ cup (160 g) sugar, ¾ cup vegetable oil, 2 large eggs, ¼ cup honey, 3 tsp vanilla

title: Sheepish maple peanut butter yogurt dip.
description: I'm feeling a little sheepish right now - I keep (foolishly) messing up and it’s kind of embarrassing. I’m constantly on the edge of saying, “Did I do that?” (Think: Urkel!). But seriously, what’s happening to me today? There’s got to be something I’m missing. Do I need help focusing? Am I hungry? Oh, there’s a thought. I think I’ll bake...
ingredients: 4 tbsp peanut butter, unsweetened, 4 tbsp Greek yogurt, 2 tsp maple syrup, 1 tsp maple extract, Strawberries, bananas, shortbread cookies, waffles

title: Thoughtful hot chocolate affogato.
description: I always feel thoughtful around this time of year. Sometimes it’s at odds with the hustle and bustle in the air and the ease with which I get swept up in it… I have a plan though - drink hot chocolate in front of a roaring fireplace, stare at Christmas tree lights until midnight or my eyes feel heavy (whichever comes first), watch the snow fall on a dark, quiet night. It all sounds magical! I think I’ll do it all but first, I think I’ll *bake*.
ingredients: 2-4 scoops French vanilla ice cream, Hot chocolate, premade, ½ tsp cocoa powder, ½ tsp cinnamon powder, 1-2 tbsp caramel sauce, Whipped cream (premade or follow the recipe below):, 250 ml heavy cream, 1 tbsp granulated sugar, ½ tbsp vanilla extract

title: Happy double chocolate cookies.
description: I.am.deliriously.happy. and I don’t need a thing (except maybe time to enjoy this floating, blissful feeling). Later, I want to share something fitting – to celebrate and commemorate it. I think I’ll bake...
ingredients: 3 oz (90 g) semi-sweet chocolate chips, ¼ cup + 2 tbsp (85 g) unsalted butter, room temperature, ¼ cup + 2 tbsp (85 g) vegetable shortening, room temperature, 2 large egg yolks, ¼ cup maple syrup, amber grade, ¾ cup (161 g) brown sugar, 2 tbsp (28 g) white sugar, 1 teaspoon vanilla extract, 1 ¾ cups (262 g) all-purpose flour, ½ cup (40 g) cocoa powder, 1 teaspoon baking soda, ¼ teaspoon salt

title: Uneasy hot ginger tea.
description: I’m feeling very uneasy right now - it’s causing a lot of anxiety and discomfort. It’s not a fun feeling but it is a useful one. It’s a warning sign telling me that something’s up. Something that’s worth looking into. While I do, I think I’ll bake.
ingredients: 1 ½ inch (20 g) fresh ginger, peeled and roughly chopped, 3 cups water, 1 tsp brown sugar

title: Foggy coffee-infused rice krispies.
description: It’s foggy outside with a little bit of rain – today’s mood in a nutshell. My mind’s blurry, unclear, like there’s something’s hidden from view, but what? It’s not a sad feeling, per se, more of a “confused and struggling with it” feeling. I think I need to dig a little deeper. While I do, I think I’ll bake.
ingredients: 8 oz unsalted butter, 21 oz marshmallows, 2 tbsp cream, warmed, 4 tsp instant coffee, ¼ tsp salt, 11.5 oz Rice Krispies cereal

title: Complicated chocolate dipped shortbread.
description: At the risk of sounding like a cranky old grandpa, “everything feels overly complicated lately” and it’s taking a toll. I want to change that vibe, reset the tone, and take control of the situation. Give me effortlessness, simplicity, and above all else, c-h-o-c-o-l-a-t-e. I think I’ll bake.At the risk of sounding like a cranky old grandpa, “everything feels overly complicated lately” and it’s taking a toll. I want to change that vibe, reset the tone, and take control of the situation. Give me effortlessness, simplicity, and above all else, c-h-o-c-o-l-a-t-e. I think I’ll bake.
ingredients: 1 ½ cups (330 g) unsalted butter, room temperature, 9 tbsp (111 g) brown granulated sugar, 3 tsp vanilla extract, ¾ tsp salt, 4 cups (480 g) all-purpose flour, 3 cups (516 g) dark chocolate chips, 3 tbsp vegetable shortening

title: Drained maple nut granola bars.
description: I feel emotionally drained, weak, exhausted. Sometimes it’s unavoidable, other times... Well, other times it’s completely avoidable if you recognize the signs (of a draining situation) and remove yourself from it. That didn’t happen this time, this time I simply wasn’t paying attention…until I was - but too late. Some time has passed, I’m ready to move on. I’m in need of something soulful, filling. I think I’ll bake.
ingredients: 1 tbsp (14 g) unsalted butter, 2 tbsp maple syrup, 1 cup (140 g) peanuts, roasted and unsalted, Pinch of salt

title: Bored herb and garlic cheese roll.
description: I’m bored. So bored. It can’t possibly get any worse… ...can it? Ugh, I take that back it can get worse. I have to do something, anything (as long as it’s productive). I think I’ll bake.
ingredients: 1 tsp, heaped, active dry yeast, ¾ cup + 2 tbsp warm water, 1 ½ tbsp honey, warmed, 1 ¾ cups + 1 ½ tbsp (290 g) all purpose flour, 1 ½ tsp coarse sea salt

title: Cautious chocolate dipped gingery banana slices.
description: I'm in a cautious mood today. It's safe but it’s wearisome. Being careful, thinking things through, deliberating, then revisiting it again is tiring…I'm not even sure if it's necessary. While I work it out, I think I'll bake.
ingredients: 1 medium banana, sliced cross-sectionally, 30 g dark chocolate, melted, 3 rounds (20 g) of crystallized ginger, minced

title: Cold maple oatmeal cookies.
description: It’s a cold morning, quiet and still. It’s raining but it feels cold enough for snow. On these mornings, the weather *is* the mood. In that case, I’m in need of warmth – I think I’ll bake.
ingredients: 1 cup (226 g) unsalted butter, room temperature, ¾ cup (160 g) brown sugar, ¼ cup + 1 tbsp (60 g) white sugar, 2 tsp vanilla extract, 2 large eggs, ¼ cup + 2 tbsp maple syrup, amber grade, 1 ½ cups (232 g) all-purpose flour, 1 tsp salt, 2 cups (210 g) rolled oats

title: Optimistic strawberries with honey in cream.
description: I’m optimistic - it’s hopeful, positive, and happy. It feels like I can handle anything (even when things get tough). It’s a sweet place to be, so while I’m here I think I’ll bake.
ingredients: 15-20 fresh strawberries, sliced into halves, Honey, to drizzle (about 3 tbsp), Whipped cream (premade or follow recipe below using:), 500 ml whipping cream, 2 tbsp sugar, 2 tsp vanilla

title: Nervous chocolate french silk pie.
description: I’m feeling nervous - the shaky kind. The kind that can only be overcome with the help of chocolate. Simple. I think I’ll bake...

title: Lonely coffee toffee muffins.
description: I’m lonely and it feels especially gloomy today. I don’t have to let it bring me down or let it take over my day - and I won’t. I’ll call up some friends or family, maybe I’ll take a walk or chat with the neighbours. Either way, I’ll make something to share. I think I’ll bake.
ingredients: 2 ¾ cup (426 g) all-purpose flour, ½ tsp salt, ½ tsp baking soda, 3 tsp baking powder, 1 cup (226 g) granulated sugar, 2 tbsp instant coffee, 1 cup (208 g) toffee chips, 3/4 cup vegetable oil, 4 eggs, room temperature, 1 cup buttermilk

title: Hopeful gingery iced tea.
description: I feel hopeful for a lot of things, and (for the first time in a long while) I feel like it’s all possible - all of it’s within my reach. It’s a bright, happy mood. I think I’ll linger here a while longer. As I do, I think I’ll bake.
ingredients: 3 inch (46 g) fresh ginger, peeled and roughly chopped, 6 cups water, 6 tea bags, 4 tbsp (50 g) brown sugar, Ice

title: By myself garlic cheesy bread sticks.
description: It’s time for a fun night in, by myself, to do all the (dreamy) things. Yes! And with any night of indulgence - there must be snacks. I’m thinking of going heavy on the cheese and garlic! Perfect! I think I'll bake.
ingredients: 1 tsp, heaped, active dry yeast, ¾ cup + 2 tbsp warm water, 1 ½ tbsp honey, warmed, 1 ¾ cups + 1 ½ tbsp (290 g) all purpose flour, 1 ½ tsp coarse sea salt

title: Ambitious lime coconut granola bars.
description: I feel ambitious in a driven yet equally flexible way. I like it. It’s fun. It’s the perfect time to be creative! Here’s what I’m thinking – out of all the possibilities, select a unique few, put them together, adapt/shift as needed, stop when I find something that works. Simple. When all is said and done, I’ll have had lots of fun and can enjoy/eat my creation. I think I’ll bake.
ingredients: 2 ½ cup (236 g) rolled oats, 1 ½ cup (54 g) rice krispies, ½ cup (46 g) fine unsweetened coconut flakes, ¼ cup + 3 tbsp honey, ¼ cup (56 g) salted butter, 2 tbsp (24 g) brown sugar, 2 tbsp lime juice

title: Happy chocolate chip muffins.
description: I’m happy - it’s a wonderful, easy, effortless “happy”. You don’t have to work for it – it just is and that right there makes me happy. I think I’ll bake.
ingredients: 2 ¾ cup (426 g) all-purpose flour, ½ tsp salt, ½ tsp baking soda, 3 tsp baking powder, 1 cup (226 g) granulated sugar, 1 cup (208 g) mini semi-sweet chocolate chips, 3/4 cup vegetable oil, 4 eggs, room temperature, 1 tsp vanilla extract, 1 cup buttermilk

title: Failing bailey’s chocolate chip cookie drops
description: Today’s one of those days where I feel like I’m failing at everything and nothing’s working, nothing at all. It’s hard not to feel completely frustrated and on the verge of tears but that’s not what I want. To avoid the gloom, I need to shift my focus toward something I can succeed at (or at the very least I can enjoy failing at). I think I’ll bake.
ingredients: 1½ cups (144 g) chocolate chips cookie crumbs, 2 tbsp Baileys

title: Irritated Ritz cookie crackers.
description: I’m so irritated that it’s slowly turning into anger –that’s no good. I *might* be a bit hangry-chocolate-chip-granola-bars">hangry too. Maybe I’ll make a quick snack before it gets any worse. I think I’ll bake.
ingredients: 1 cup (172 g) dark chocolate chips, 1 tbsp vegetable shortening, 20 Ritz crackers, Peanut butter chips or Toffee chips

title: Misunderstood honey rose tea bread.
description: I hate being misunderstood. It’s frustrating when nothing can be done about it either. Making peace with it is (sometimes) as good as it gets and that *sucks*. Until I get there, I think I'll bake.
ingredients: ¾ tbsp active dry yeast, 1½ cups warm water, ¼ cup honey, warmed, 2 tbsp rose water, 3¼ cups + 2 tbsp (533 g) all purpose flour, ½ tbsp coarse sea salt

title: Focused banana maple peanut butter muffins.
description: Today, I have to be laser focused. All my attention will be directed at one thing for the long haul. In order to stay focused, I’ll need to eat (to avoid hangry-chocolate-chip-granola-bars">hangry-ness)... before I start, I think I'll bake.
ingredients: 2 cups (304 g) all purpose flour, ¼ tsp salt, ½ tsp baking soda, 2 tsp baking powder, 1½ cups (340 g) ripe and mashed banana (3 bananas), ¼ cup maple syrup, 3 tbsp peanut butter, ½ cup (127 g) sugar, ¾ cup vegetable oil, 2 large eggs

title: Hustle chocolate coffee spread.
description: I’ve got to hustle today – push harder, move faster and think smarter. No time to stop, no room for breaks but, extra room for melodrama (it seems). Don’t get locked into this way of thinking. There is time to breathe, to stop, to take a break. I’ll just need to be careful not to amble because there’s a lot to do and I’m excited to do it. It’s a thin line between hustling and feeling crazed (see overwhelmed-strawberry-peach-trifle">overwhelmed). I can’t forget to eat either (see hangry-chocolate-chip-granola-bars">hangry). I think I’ll bake.
ingredients: 1 tbsp (14 g) salted butter, room temperature, ½ tsp honey, 2 tbsp (26 g) dark chocolate chips, ½ tsp instant coffee

title: Carefree honey dipped strawberries in toasted coconut and oats.
opening_title: honey dipped strawberries in toasted coconut and oats.
description: I feel carefree, weightless – it’s a sudden, unexpected feeling that’s always delightful! Delightfully sweet. Hmmm, that sounds perfect right now. I think I’ll *bake*.
ingredients: ½ lb (about 8) fresh strawberries, 2 tbsp honey, 1 tbsp rolled oats, ½ tbsp unsweetened coconut flakes

title: Monday caramelized peaches n’ rum sauce.
description: It's Monday - the kind of Monday that I had (happily) mistook for Thursday. But it's not Thursday. It's.Still.Monday. Ugh...Monday. I think I'll bake.
ingredients: ¾ cup (171 g) brown sugar, 2 ¼ tbsp (31.5 g) unsalted butter, room temperature, ¾ cup water, 2½ tsp vanilla extract, 3 cups (402 g) peaches, sliced, ¼ cup + 2 tbsp spiced rum (or maple syrup for an alcohol-free version), Pinch of kosher salt

title: Stormy crusty apple bread.
description: I'm feeling stormy; dark, tumultuous. To say I'm angry doesn’t quite cut it, I'm struggling with it too. I need to clear my head and calm down. I think I'll bake...
ingredients: 2 medium (230 g) granny smith apples, peeled and cubed (or 3-4 small red green apples, weighing the same amount), 2 ¼ tsp active dry yeast, 2 tbsp (28 g) salted butter, melted, 1 ½ cup warm water, ¾ cup (100 g) whole wheat flour, 2 ½ cup (400 g) all purpose flour, ½ tbsp coarse sea salt, 3 tbsp all purpose flour

title: Hangry chocolate chip granola bars.
description: I’m.hangry. and slow to process...I am irritable – that I know. It won’t get better until I do something about it, but I feel sluggish. I’ll need to be resourceful. I think I’ll bake.
ingredients: 2 ½ cup (236 g) rolled oats, divided, 1 ½ cup (54 g) rice krispies, ½ cup (110 g) mini semi-sweet chocolate chips, plus extra for sprinkling, ¼ cup + 3 tbsp honey, ¼ cup (56 g) salted butter, melted, 2 tbsp (24 g) brown sugar

title: Relieved milk and honey buns.
description: Feeling relieved? Phew. After all the worry, the stress, and the fear - things are (finally) going your way. Sighs of relief and constant smiling mark the change. The fact that it’s working out the way you’d hoped is not lost on you. There’s a calm, contented, at ease feeling that spreads from your fingers to your toes. There’s nothing left to do but savor this relief (and bake).
ingredients: 1 ½ tbsp active dry yeast, 3 cups milk, warmed, ½ cup honey, warmed, 6 ¾ cup (1 kg or 1066 g) all purpose flour, 1 tbsp coarse sea salt

title: Fortunate marble cake.
description: At times like this, I realize how fortunate I am. There’s a lot to be grateful for and I can’t help but feel lucky - even for the little things.  It’s worth sharing any way I can. I think I’ll bake.
ingredients: Spray oil, for greasing the bundt pan, 2 ¾ cups + 1 tbsp (329 g) all purpose flour, ½ tsp salt, ½ tsp baking soda, 1 tsp baking powder, ¾ cup vegetable oil, 2 cups (368 g) granulated sugar, 4 eggs, at room temperature, 1 tsp vanilla extract, 1 cup buttermilk, 3 tbsp cocoa powder, ½ tbsp granulated sugar

title: Moody creamy cheesecake parfait with bailey’s chocolate sauce.
opening_title: creamy cheesecake parfait with bailey’s chocolate sauce.
description: I’m moody and emotional and it’s a miserable place to be! Although, knowing I’m in a mood doesn’t actually make it easier to deal with. In this case, the best option is to move forward, make the best of it and get on with it. No point lingering here longer than I have to. I think I’ll bake.
ingredients: Whipped cream (premade or follow recipe below using:), 250 ml whipping cream, 1 tbsp sugar, 2 tsp vanilla, Chocolate baileys sauce:, 100 g semi-sweet chocolate, chopped, 1 tbsp (14 g) unsalted butter, 2 tbsp Baileys Irish Cream liqueur, Parfait:, 250 g cream cheese, softened, ¾ cup whipped cream, 1 ½ tsp sugar, Oreo crumbs, brownie chunks, or toppings of choice

title: Fiery maple cayenne muffins.
description: I.AM.fiery. Without question. Without fear. Without doubt. I got this! With that in mind, I think I’ll bake.
ingredients: 2 cups (304 g) all purpose flour, ¼ tsp salt, ½ tsp baking soda, 2 tsp baking powder, ½ tsp cayenne pepper, ¾ cup (160 g) sugar, ¾ cup vegetable oil, 2 large eggs, ¼ cup maple syrup, 3 tsp maple extract, ½ cup milk

title: Friday fudgy brownies.
description: It’s Friday. Yay! It's a day of endless possibilities, a day of fun, it's a day sweeter than the rest. Nothing can make this day better except, maybe, chocolate. I think I'll bake.
ingredients: ¾ cup (170 g) unsalted butter, 3 oz (90 g) semi-sweet chocolate chips, 2 large eggs, at room temperature, 1 ½ cups (300 g) granulated sugar, 1 tbsp vanilla extract, ¾ tsp coarse salt, ½ cup (40 g) cocoa powder, ½ cup (70 g) all-purpose flour

title: Contemplative cranberry ginger rose tea.
description: I’m in a quiet, contemplative mood - completely lost in thought. There are times when it’s a necessary progression (in order to figure things out) but that doesn’t mean it’s easy. It might help to have something to take along the (introspective) way. I think I'll *bake*.
ingredients: 3 inch (45 g) fresh ginger, peeled and roughly chopped, 3 cups water, 3 cups cranberry raspberry juice, 3 tsp rose water

title: Stressed chocolate coffee buttercreams.
description: I’m stressed; the stressed kind of stressed. It’s a lot to deal with and it looks like I’ll be stuck here for a while. I may as well make something (to enjoy) while I’m at it. I think I’ll bake...
ingredients: ¾ cup (140 g) semi-sweet chocolate chips, ¾ tbsp (6 g) vegetable shortening, 1 tbsp (14 g) unsalted butter, at room temperature, 1 tbsp (14 g) cream cheese, at room temperature, Pinch of salt, ¼ cup + 2 tbsp (47 g) icing sugar, ½ tbsp instant coffee (or ¾ tbsp for a stronger coffee flavour), ½ tsp hot cream

title: Antsy honey pepper muffins.
description: I'm antsy - it’s a deeply fidgety, “on edge” feeling and I can’t sit still any longer. I have to do something about it. I think I'll bake.
ingredients: 2 cups (304 g) all purpose flour, ¼ tsp salt, ½ tsp baking soda, 2 tsp baking powder, 2 tsp of black pepper, ¾ cup (160 g) sugar, ¾ cup vegetable oil, 2 large eggs, ¼ cup honey, 3 tsp vanilla, ½ cup milk

title: Lost golden rice krispies.
description: I'm lost. I’m trying to move forward but I’m feeling disoriented and uncertain. Maybe instead of moving forward, I’ll focus on what's next. Eventually, I’ll find my way. I think I’ll bake.
ingredients: 8 oz unsalted butter, 21 oz marshmallows, 2 tbsp maple syrup, ¼ tsp salt, 12 oz Rice Krispies brown rice cereal

title: Peaceful cardamom pancakes with cream.
description: It's a warm, sunny morning; peaceful and perfect. All that's missing is a hot cup of tea and something to enjoy with it. I think I’ll bake.
ingredients: 1 cup (148 g) all purpose flour, 1 tsp baking powder, ½ tsp baking soda, 2 tbsp brown sugar, 1 tbsp cardamom powder, 2 tbsp (28 g) salted butter, melted, 1 cup buttermilk, 1 large egg, 3 tbsp water, 1 tbsp vanilla extract, Whipped cream (premade or follow recipe below using:), 250 ml whipping cream, 1 tbsp sugar, 2 tsp vanilla

title: Frustrated kitchen sink cookies.
description: It’s been an endlessly frustrating week and it’s only Tuesday, typical, but I’m not having it. I’ll do something to lighten the mood. I think I’ll bake.
ingredients: 1 cup (226 g) unsalted butter, room temperature, ¼ cup (50 g) granulated sugar, ½ cup (115 g) firmly packed brown sugar, 2 large eggs, at room temperature, 2 tsp vanilla extract, 1 ½ cups (242 g) all purpose flour, 1 tsp baking soda, ½ tsp salt, 1 ¼ cups (131 g) old-fashioned rolled oats, 2 cups (400 g) semi-sweet chocolate chips, ¾ cup (83 g) walnuts, coarsely chopped, ¾ cup (138 g) Sultana or Thompson raisins, ¾ cup (95 g) sweetened desiccated flaked coconut

title: Tired gingery maple and carrot muffins.
description: I'm tired - the keep-moving-or-you'll-feel-like-shit tired. I guess I know what I’ll be doing today. I think I'll bake...
ingredients: 2 cups (304 g) all purpose flour, ¼ tsp salt, ½ tsp baking soda, 2 tsp baking powder, ¾ cup (200 g) sugar, ¾ cup vegetable oil, 2 large eggs, ¼ cup + 2 tbsp maple syrup, 2 tbsp (30 g) fresh grated ginger (taken from a 2-inch fresh piece of ginger), 2 cups (161 g) grated carrot (2 carrots)

title: Sad cranberry ginger tea.
description: I'm feeling sad. It’s the kind of sad you can't get away from - you just have to go through it and move on with it. I think I'll bake.
ingredients: 3 inch (45 g) fresh ginger, peeled and roughly chopped, 3 cups water, 3 cups cranberry raspberry juice, 5 fresh mint leaves

title: Adrift milk and honey bread.
description: I'm adrift - like a boat lost on the water. Being aimless, at a loss, and completely directionless only makes it feel worse. It’s better to turn to something that brings a little comfort (and comes with instructions). I think I'll bake.
ingredients: 1 ½ tbsp active dry yeast, 3 cups milk, warmed, ½ cup honey, warmed, 6 ¾ cup (1 kg or 1066 g) all purpose flour, 1 tbsp coarse sea salt

title: Monday coffee creme brownies.
description: It’s Monday and it definitely feels like it. It's not a "Monday" that could be mistaken for any other day. It's full-on Monday feels and I don’t like it. I think I’ll bake.
ingredients: ¼ cup + 1 ½ tbsp (77 g) unsalted butter, melted, 1.5 oz (45 g) semi-sweet chocolate chips, 1 large egg, at room temperature, ¾ cup (150 g) granulated sugar, ½ tsp vanilla extract, ¼ tsp coarse salt, ¼ cup (20 g) cocoa powder, ¼ cup (35 g) all purpose flour, ¾ tsp instant coffee, ½ tsp hot cream

title: Nervous lemon poppy seed cake.
description: I’m nervous, a queasy nervous - the kind that's lingering, exhausting and unavoidable. It's manageable if I keep busy. I think I’ll bake.
ingredients: Spray oil, for greasing the bundt pan, 2 ¾ cups (339 g) cake flour, ½ tsp salt, ½ tsp baking soda, 1 tsp baking powder, ¾ cup vegetable oil, 2¼ cups (425 g) granulated sugar, 4 eggs, at room temperature, 1 tsp vanilla extract, 1 cup buttermilk, ¼ cup (35 g) poppy seeds, 15-20 g grated lemon zest (2 large lemons)

title: Weekend chocolate chip peanut butter lime cookies.
opening_title: chocolate chip peanut butter lime cookies.
description: We’ve reached the (much-needed) weekend. Technically, every weekend is much needed by the time it comes around but let's start off this one with something fun! I think I’ll bake.
ingredients: ½ cup (113 g) unsalted butter, room temperature, ½ cup (110 g) brown sugar, ¼ cup (54 g) white sugar, 2 large egg yolks , Grated zest and juice of one lime, ½ cup (120 g) natural (and unsweetened) peanut butter, 1 ½ cups (232 g) all-purpose flour, 1 teaspoon baking soda, ¼ teaspoon salt, ¾ cup (143 g) semi-sweet chocolate chips

title: Awake maple brown sugar shortbread.
description: I’m lying awake (with too many thoughts) and I can’t fall asleep. I should get up and find something to do until I'm ready to drift off. I think I’ll bake.
ingredients: ½ cup (110 g) unsalted butter, ¼ cup (50 g) brown sugar, 1 tsp maple extract, ¼ tsp salt, 1 ⅓ cups (160 g) all-purpose flour

title: Dreary sour crusty bread.
description: It’s a dreary morning; gloomy and dark. It’s a comforting-only-if-you're-inside-and-baking-kind of morning. So, I think I’ll bake.
ingredients: ¾ tbsp active dry yeast, 1 tbsp honey, 1 tbsp salted butter, melted, 1 ½ cups warm water, 1 ½ cups (242 g) whole wheat flour, 1 ¾ cups (295 g) all purpose flour, ½ tbsp coarse sea salt, 3 tbsp whole wheat flour

title: Nostalgic OG Chocolate Chip Cookies.
description: I’m nostalgic, bordering on wistful, and I miss all the things. If ever there was a time to make something homemade that’s chock-full of memories, and the right amount of sweetness - it would be now. I think I’ll bake...
ingredients: ½ cup (113 g) unsalted butter, room temperature, ¾ cup (161 g) brown sugar, 2 tbsp (28 g) white sugar, 1 teaspoon vanilla extract, 2 large egg yolks, ¼ cup maple syrup, amber grade, 1 ½ cups (232 g) all-purpose flour, 1 teaspoon baking soda, ¼ teaspoon salt, ¾ cup (143 g) semi-sweet chocolate chips

title: Overwhelmed strawberry peach trifle.
description: I’m awfully busy today and already I’m feeling overwhelmed. You know the kind; the day has just begun, the to-do list is jam-packed, the mountain looks insurmountable...but I have some pockets of free time throughout the day to do something fun. I think I’ll bake.
ingredients: 300 g lady fingers, crumbled, 1 tbsp spiced rum, 398 ml/14 fl oz can of peach slices, drained and chopped, 340 g fresh strawberries, chopped, 800 g vanilla pudding, 2 tbsp slivered almonds, Whipped cream (premade or follow recipe below):, 500 ml heavy cream, 2 tbsp granulated sugar, 1 tbsp vanilla extract
